flags.t: Spot is inside an ATV (all terrain vehicle) for Hunting Closed Area: South Chilcotin and M.U. 5-14. Closed between 4:00 a.m. and 10:00 a.m. from September 1 to November 30. Synopsis map 4-2/23.

seasonRows.notes: No row in the Region 5 table, so no general open season (page 5: open seasons are only those in the synopsis). Moose in Region 5: check the LEH synopsis.

plan: Drive: from Resort Municipality of Whistler, about 161 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 51.20452, -122.65312, pull off on Gaspard Red Mountain FSR (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: 880 m SW, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 18 m, about 19 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: moose, season: VERIFY. Glass the wetland and cutblock edges at dawn and dusk. Move slowly, stop often (Tip).
Use: .308 Winchester, 165 to 180 grain premium bullet, shots inside about 200 m (219 yd) (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 5-3, Region 5. Season: no general open season (synopsis page 44, 95%). 3 legal flags below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-09-27, closures 2026-10-16.
R3A-moose-walk-0002.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 5-3: about 302 hunter days a year for moose (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.08 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: average access. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Good for 2
tags.why: Cover edge here (cutblock or burn): one hunter sits at a crossing or glasses, the other walks the edge slowly with the wind at their back toward the stander. Agree zones of fire, a meeting point and a time at the truck (Tip, lesson: Hunting with a partner). Pushes are on foot only (99%, synopsis page 11, item 25).

tags.label: Good solo
tags.why: Short pack out: 0.9 km and about 18 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).
